s.how: Fill 4 sandwiches with 200g sliced cheddar and butter the outsides. Toast in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, then cut in half.

s.note: New England in the dead of winter
s.how: Fry 3 chopped rashers of bacon and a diced onion. Add 300g diced potatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 400g tinned clams and 200ml cream and heat through.

m.note: the makeshift Christmas for the three left behind
m.how: Fill a whole chicken with stuffing made from 150g breadcrumbs, diced onion and chopped sage. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes with 800g potatoes around it and rest before carving.

w.note: Mr Hunham's flaming cherries jubilee at the restaurant
w.how: Simmer 500g pitted cherries with 60g sugar and a splash of water for 5 minutes. Warm 60ml brandy, pour over, light carefully and spoon over 1L vanilla ice cream once the flames die.

d.note: the bottle in Mr Hunham's desk
d.how: Pour 45ml bourbon over ice in 4 short glasses. Have 1.25L ginger ale ready over ice for the students and anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
